messages.subject: 'Open Type' or 'Open Resource' equivalent in StatET
messages.subject_clean: 'Open Type' or 'Open Resource' equivalent in StatET
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I am developing tool for data-flow processing:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvfS-lPXeKjMoFAhKIzyf7A (my google
channel).

I plan to add now a support for R.

I already add support for Java (
http://systemincloud.com/tasks/#0.8.0/commons/javatask) and Python (
http://systemincloud.com/tasks/#0.8.0/commons/pythontask).

To integrate R easily I would like to combine StatET editor with mine. I
have done similarly for Python by using PyDev API.

First feature I would like to use is something like 'Open Type' from JDT
or 'Open Resource'. I would like to look for R6Classes that inherit
particular R6Class. Is it possible with StatET code?

Thanks,

Marek Jagielski

messages.subject: Re: AST equivalent in StatET
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
Can I ask you for some hints how to use AST of StatET.

I am playing with:

                        IFile file = (IFile) element;
                        if(file.getFileExtension() == null)
 return false;
                        if(file.getFullPath().toString().equals(path))
return false;

                        String ext = file.getFileExtension();
                        if(ext.equals("R")) {
                            IContentDescription contentDescription;
                            try {
                                contentDescription =
file.getContentDescription();
                                IContentType contentType =
contentDescription.getContentType();
                                IRWorkspaceSourceUnit su =
(IRWorkspaceSourceUnit) sum.getSourceUnit(LTK.PERSISTENCE_CONTEXT, element,
contentType, true, null);
                                IRModelInfo mi = (IRModelInfo)
su.getModelInfo(RModel.R_TYPE_ID, IRModelManager.MODEL_FILE, new
NullProgressMonitor());
                                IRLangSourceElement se =
mi.getSourceElement();
                                List<? extends IRLangSourceElement> vars =
se.getSourceChildren(new IModelElement.Filter() {
                                    @Override public boolean
include(IModelElement el) {
                                        if((el.getElementType() &
IRElement.MASK_C1) == IRElement.C1_VARIABLE) return true;
                                        return false;
                                    }
                                });

With the code above I am able to detect: MyRTask and rtaskinfo as
variables. Particulary, I would like to detect if this variable is R6 class
and inherits RTask. I see in debug that such information I could get in
children of internal field fAccess.

What is the proper way to analyse code using StatET API. Is it possible
without internal plugins code?

Thanks for any hint,

Marek Jagielski

messages.subject: Re: AST equivalent in StatET
messages.body_plain:
Hi Marek,

I think for such analysis you have to switch to the AST:

IAstNode node= (IAstNode.class) el.getAdapter(IAstNode.class);
if (node instanceof Assignment) {
	RAstNode sourceNode= ((Assignment) node).getSourceChild();
	if (sourceNode instanceof FCall) {
		FCall.Args args= ((FCall) sourceNode).getArgsChild();
		...
}

Regards,
Stephan
